prompt: Don't forget to (say / tell) goodbye to your aunt before you catch the train.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «say goodbye» (попрощаться) всегда используется глагол say.

prompt: Every night before going to sleep, the child (says / tells) a short prayer beside her bed.
explanation_ru: Слово «prayer» (молитва) сочетается с глаголом say в значении «произносить молитву» (say a prayer).

prompt: The auditor's final document (said / told) nothing about the missing invoices from the previous quarter.
explanation_ru: Для передачи содержания текста или отчёта без прямого дополнения лица используется глагол say (say nothing about).

prompt: Did anyone (say / tell) Marcus about the sudden change in the board meeting schedule?
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат без предлога (tell someone about something).

prompt: You should have (said / told) the waiter immediately that the soup was completely cold.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «tell someone that...» требует глагола tell, так как сразу указан получатель информации (the waiter).

prompt: No matter how convincingly a witness (says / tells) lies in court, forensic evidence eventually reveals the truth.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «tell lies» (лгать, говорить неправду) всегда используется глагол tell.

prompt: Can your younger brother (say / tell) the time on an analogue clock yet, or does he still rely on his phone?
explanation_ru: Выражение «tell the time» означает «определять время по часам» и требует глагола tell.

prompt: Just by watching the swallows fly low over the meadow, the farmer could (say / tell) that heavy rain was coming.
explanation_ru: В значении «понять, догадаться, определить по признакам» используется глагол tell.

prompt: The mysterious street artist is (said / told) to have painted all seven murals across the city in a single night.
explanation_ru: В пассивной конструкции для передачи слухов и мнений («говорят, что он...») используется форма «is said to...».

prompt: The sign on the museum door (says / tells) “No flash photography”, so please turn yours off now.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о надписи на табличке, вывеске или в тексте, используется глагол say (the sign says).

prompt: The flight tracker (says / tells) our plane will land in Zurich twenty minutes ahead of schedule.
explanation_ru: Приборы, экраны и программы «показывают/сообщают» информацию с помощью глагола say без указания адресата.

prompt: The referee (said / told) the players to step back ten yards before the free kick.
explanation_ru: Для передачи приказа или просьбы с указанием лица используется конструкция «tell someone to do something».

prompt: What were you (saying / telling) to the receptionist when I walked into the lobby?
explanation_ru: Глагол say требует предлога to перед адресатом (say something to someone).

prompt: These two Baroque painters used such similar brushwork that even art historians struggle to (say / tell) their canvases apart. Yesterday, the gallery director (said / told) reporters that a new pigment test will solve the mystery. She also (said / told) us that the exhibition will open next Friday.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «tell apart» означает «различать»; далее используется «tell someone that...» с прямым дополнением лица (reporters, us).

prompt: How do plant experts (say / tell) a safe wild mushroom from a dangerous twin? During the field class, our teacher (said / told) that white spots are the clearest sign. He then (said / told) the students to pick samples carefully.
explanation_ru: В значении «отличать одно от другого» употребляется «tell A from B»; далее «say that» (без лица) и «tell someone to do» (с указанием лица).

prompt: I offered to pay for the scratched sunglasses, and the shop assistant (said / told) no with a polite smile. She (said / told) me that the display pair was already damaged. Before I left, I (said / told) thank you and bought a case instead.
explanation_ru: Со словами «no» и «thank you» используется say (say no, say thank you), а перед личным местоимением me без предлога ставится told.

prompt: Mountain guides (say / tell) that marmots always whistle loudly when an eagle flies over the valley. Yesterday, our guide (said / told) us to stay quiet near the rocks. He (said / told) it was the best way to spot them.
explanation_ru: Когда адресат не назван, используется say (say that..., he said it was...); при наличии дополнения us требуется told.

prompt: My great-aunt always (says / tells) us stories about working in the old post office during the 1950s. She often (says / tells) that telegrams felt far more exciting than modern text messages. Whenever we visit, we ask her to (say / tell) us another memory.
explanation_ru: Со словом «stories» и перед дополнением «us» употребляется tell; в конструкции без указания собеседника («says that...») выбирается say.

prompt: “Please fasten your belts for landing,” the flight worker (said / told) over the speaker a few minutes ago. She also (said / told) passengers to raise their window covers. After landing, the pilot (said / told) goodbye to everyone at the exit.
explanation_ru: Прямая речь и фраза «say goodbye» требуют глагола say, тогда как конструкция «tell passengers to...» строится с глаголом tell.

prompt: Honestly, nobody in the room smiled when the host (said / told) his opening joke. Later, he (said / told) his friend that he felt terribly nervous on stage. His friend (said / told) him not to worry about it.
explanation_ru: В выражении «tell a joke» (рассказать шутку) и во всех конструкциях с прямым дополнением лица (his friend, him) используется глагол tell.

prompt: She was so nervous during the oral exam that she froze and ___ nothing for ten seconds.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «say nothing» (ничего не сказать) без указания собеседника используется форма said.

prompt: Did the coordinator ___ the volunteers when they could take their lunch break?
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует прямое дополнение лица (the volunteers) без предлога.

prompt: If you promise not to post it online, I'll ___ you a secret about next season's cast.
explanation_ru: Выражение «tell someone a secret» (рассказать кому-либо секрет) всегда требует глагола tell.

prompt: Read the label on the jar — it should ___ on the side how long to simmer the sauce.
explanation_ru: Для описания текста на упаковке или этикетке без указания адресата используется глагол say.

prompt: The dentist ___ me that my wisdom teeth didn't need to be removed after all.
explanation_ru: Перед личным местоимением me без предлога to употребляется глагол told (told me that...).

prompt: Even after testing both microphones side by side, the sound engineer couldn't say the difference.
answer: Even after testing both microphones side by side, the sound engineer couldn't tell the difference.
accepted_answers: Even after testing both microphones side by side, the sound engineer couldn't tell the difference.
Even after testing both microphones side by side, the sound engineer could not tell the difference.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «tell the difference» (видеть/понимать разницу) используется глагол tell, а не say.

prompt: Tell hello to Claire for me if you see her at the conference tomorrow.
answer: Say hello to Claire for me if you see her at the conference tomorrow.
accepted_answers: Say hello to Claire for me if you see her at the conference tomorrow.
explanation_ru: С приветствиями используется глагол say и предлог to: «say hello to someone» (передать привет кому-либо).

prompt: Our swimming coach has repeatedly told the team not to run near the edge of the pool.
answer: Our swimming coach has repeatedly told the team not to run near the edge of the pool.
accepted_answers: Our swimming coach has repeatedly told the team not to run near the edge of the pool.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: конструкция «tell someone not to do something» требует глагола told и прямого дополнения (the team).

prompt: No matter how difficult the situation gets, it is always better to say the truth.
answer: No matter how difficult the situation gets, it is always better to tell the truth.
accepted_answers: No matter how difficult the situation gets, it is always better to tell the truth.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «tell the truth» (говорить правду) употребляется глагол tell, а не say.

prompt: You want to mention a general weather rumour you heard around town without naming who told you.
options: They say that this summer is going to be the hottest in twenty years.
They tell that this summer is going to be the hottest in twenty years.
They say us that this summer is going to be the hottest in twenty years.
They told that this summer is going to be the hottest in twenty years.
explanation_ru: Безличное «They say that...» (говорят, что...) используется без указания адресата; глагол tell требует прямого дополнения лица.

prompt: You are explaining to a friend what the nurse advised you to do with your eye drops.
options: The nurse said me to use the drops twice a day.
The nurse told that I should use the drops twice a day.
The nurse told to me that I should use the drops twice a day.
The nurse said that I should use the drops twice a day.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «say that + придаточное предложение» не требует указания собеседника, тогда как после tell обязательно ставится лицо без предлога to.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using «tell» instead of «predict»: An old palmist at the festival offered to predict my future for ten euros.
answer: An old palmist at the festival offered to tell my future for ten euros.
accepted_answers: An old palmist at the festival offered to tell my future for ten euros.
An old palmist at the festival offered to tell my fortune for ten euros.
explanation_ru: В значении «предсказывать будущее / судьбу» в английском языке используется устойчивое выражение «tell the future» (или «tell someone's fortune»).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using «say» instead of «is written»: It is written on the boarding pass that the gate closes twenty minutes before departure.
answer: It says on the boarding pass that the gate closes twenty minutes before departure.
accepted_answers: It says on the boarding pass that the gate closes twenty minutes before departure.
explanation_ru: Для указания на текст в билете, документе или объявлении используется безличная конструкция «It says on... that...».
